text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Good morning.
Looking forward to working with you todayâª

Victoire Pisa and her generation-mates
had begun holding joint training sessions
quite frequently.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*!
Ah, I'm completely out of breath――!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "However, your time was significantly cut compared to the other day. Look, especially the latter half is splendid."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Your shoulders are raised by 0.8 cm.
Along with that, the range of motion in your shoulder blades is restricted.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"It could be a habit, or perhaps unnecessary tension.
Even my shoulders tend to rise when I feel rushed."

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, whew.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Haah! Just as expected, Rose's final stretch kick is incredible.
When it comes to a neck-and-neck fight, it's particularly breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, you... Especially when you're in the right headspace,
your focus is truly astounding.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Today's anchoring went swimmingly!
It's practically like having the ultimate buff applied.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, after taking a short break,
shall we do one more run?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh—trial and error is essential for improving one's skills. Of course.

"With every encounter they open up to each other,
learning more and more through one another's running."
The joint training seemed to be going successfully... or so it appeared.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Flash-san?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me.
I was just lost in thought for a moment.
...However.
choice_data_list: Has Flash stopped coming around as much?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
She said she was busy with her own training.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My apologies...
The reason being, I raised the intensity level of my individual training regimen by one step.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Because of that, there was no room left to schedule joint training sessions—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Making individual training
the top priority is only natural."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's not mandatory in the first place, so
it's something you only need to attend when you have the time, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...This still isn't enough.
To be out of breath this quickly at this workload...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...
I won't make it in time for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Flash-san...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...... She is a person of meticulous planning,
so she surely wouldn't push herself to the point of ruining her health.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "...I worried that by slowly drifting away like this, she might eventually end up completely alone."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Could that loneliness end up bringing about a bad outcome for her...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I wish to maintain a gentle connection with her.
Therefore, I have a request."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Would it be alright if I occasionally held independent training sessions scheduled alongside yours, Flash-san?

Independent training easily becomes a lonely affair,
so she likely just wanted to casually check in on things.

Right now, she doesn't need to do extra training on her own.
On the other hand, it's not like she needs to rest either.
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's do that, as long as you don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

From this day forward, she often went down
to the track for Eishin Flash's sake.

Victoire Pisa was unassuming,
yet remarkably dedicated.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Pisa-san.
What a coincidence, good morning."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Flash-san.
Perfect timing, take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The morning dew on the turf is so beautiful.
It sparkles just like crystal.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Split the frozen treat in half, you say?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's an ice pop you split in half.
Mirako-san gave it to me yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I heard it was extraordinarily delicious,
so if you'd like... would you care for some?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Flash-san!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san.
My... we certainly have been running into each other often lately.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. Mind if I join you?
Actually, there is a part of the math assignment
I'd love to get your thoughts on—

Her days of watching over Eishin Flash
continued for a while.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, thank goodness. It turned on.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
thank you so much for fixing it.
Sorry to trouble you when you're so busy, it was a huge help.
choice_data_list: By the way, what are you going to do with that?
By the way, what are you going to do with that?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I'm thinking of putting it outside the window at night.
Flash-san has been training late into the evening recently."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: The dorms get quite dark around curfew. It might only be a small comfort, but I thought even a little light would bring some peace of mind.
For all the effort it took, it seemed doubtful whether Eishin Flash would even notice.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
It is quite alright; in fact, it is better if it goes unnoticed."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If they don't notice it,
then that simply means it isn't necessary.
"—On the way back after parting with her, I looked back and saw that the lantern had already been brought outside."

Under the lingering twilight of the winter sky,
a soft light continued to sway in that single spot.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...
Oh dear, I am two minutes late returning home.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
…………
Is that lantern... lit up again?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"As I thought, it's Pisa-san's room...
Without fail whenever night falls—but why?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even if you light a lamp in a place like that,
only Umamusume heading back to the dorms would ever notice—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...It can't be.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Um...
Please don't worry about it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san... No, I realized last night
why the two of you have been
so concerned about me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san is a very busy person as well.
I would feel terribly guilty
to take up any more of her time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san...
However—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It might not be my place to say this,
especially after you've shown me such kindness.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even so, please,
use this time for the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I understand.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...
I have done something terrible.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Not only did you notice, but I made you worry about me too...
I'm so clumsy at this, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"We should not sever our ties with her right now.
My feelings on that haven't changed."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, the way we've been doing things hasn't been working.
In that case, we should change our approach.

And—together with her,
we devised a plan
aimed at the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

Whether those preparations will bring fortune or ruin...
The Hopeful Stakes is just around the corner.
